description: We are building a SaaS tool that screens CVs and ranks job applicants for recruiters at other companies.
Our HR department bought a third-party AI tool that shortlists applicants for our open positions. We only use it.
A chatbot on our online shop answers customer questions about orders and returns. We built it on an LLM API.
An email spam filter that we develop and run for our own employees' mailboxes.
Our bank develops a model that calculates consumers' credit scores to decide on personal loan applications.
A city council wants a system that scores citizens' general trustworthiness from their social behaviour and uses the score to limit access to public services.
Software for our call centre that analyses agents' faces and voices during calls to detect their emotions and report stress levels to managers.
A university develops a proctoring tool that watches students via webcam during online exams and flags suspected cheating.
Our app lets users generate realistic marketing images from text prompts. We develop the image generation system.
A streaming platform recommends films and series to viewers based on what they watched before.
An insurer builds a model that sets individual life insurance premiums based on applicants' health and lifestyle data.
A system for emergency call centres that prioritises incoming calls and decides which ambulance to dispatch first.
We are an AI lab releasing a large general-purpose language model that other companies integrate into their products via our API.
A company wants to build a facial recognition database by scraping face images from social media and the internet at large.
A logistics firm uses an AI system to evaluate warehouse workers' productivity and recommend who gets promoted or dismissed.
Demand forecasting for a supermarket chain's inventory, predicting how many products to order each week.
A migration authority wants a tool that assesses asylum applications and the credibility of applicants' statements.
An AI system acting as a safety component that controls pressure valves in a regional gas distribution network.
A tool that helps judges by researching case law and suggesting how the law applies to the facts of a case.
A voice assistant for a bank's phone line that talks to customers, answers FAQs and books appointments; it makes no credit decisions.
